name: Japanese Ginger Beef Stir-Fry with Mushrooms, Peas, Green Onions & Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
1 lb cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with additional broth, soy sauce, cornstarch, fish sauce, and sugar. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 clove garlic
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
¼ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp cornstarch
4 tsp fish sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots.
When the mushrooms are done, add carrots, beef, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb lean ground beef
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the beef is cooking, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.

When the beef is done, add the sauce, half of the green onions, and peas to the skillet (reserve remaining green onions for the next step). Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened, 1 minute more. Remove stir-fry from heat.

Divide rice and stir-fry between containers, then sprinkle with the reserved green onions. Set aside to cool completely, about 30 minutes. Cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Reheat in an oven or microwave and enjoy!
